capabilities: Capture or upload photos of handwritten pages and documents
Correct page perspective with automatic or manual four-corner detection
Remove background by color sampling and adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, or black-and-white filters
Export images as PNG, JPG, or SVG to selectable vault folders
Insert an embed link into the active note at the cursor position
extras: Manual installation is warned to crash on mobile devices; the README recommends installing via BRAT until the official community plugin release. Optional notebook-themed styling (backgrounds, pen colors, image recoloring) works only with SVG exports and requires separate CSS snippets.
intentEvidence: Inspired by document scanning apps and the Obsidian community
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture, crop, and enhance photos of physical notebook pages before embedding them in notes.

relations.evidence: Optional notebook theme CSS snippets available from Obsidian-Notebook-Themes by @CyanVoxel

summary: Image scanner that turns photos of handwritten pages into cleaned, perspective-corrected images saved to vault folders and embedded in notes.
